title: Morgiana
writer: Vladimír Bor, Alexander Grin, Juraj Herz
actors: Iva Janzurová, Josef Abrhám, Nina Divísková
plot: Klara and Viktoria are sisters. Their father dies, leaving most of his property to Klara. When Klara becomes involved with a man that her sister loves, Viktoria begins to plot her murder.
